detail.longDescription: I am unsure if # specdriven_development leads us somewhere. With traditional software development, we understood the requirements and the code. We omitted anything that did not improve the overall situation. We had abstractions from which we composed new features. Today, code and documentation are so vast that we struggle to understand/answer anything without # agenticai . We may ship stuff a bit faster now, at the aforementioned costs, but the organisation’s processes eat up that speed anyway.
